name: floci
description: Light, fluffy, and always free - The AWS Local Emulator alternative
one_liner: A free tool that pretends to be Amazon's cloud (AWS) on your own laptop, so developers can test cloud-dependent code without an AWS account or any cloud bill.
buyer: A backend developer or small startup team that wants to test AWS-dependent code locally and cheaply, without paying for a commercial local-AWS emulator license.
business_use_cases: A startup's engineering team runs it in CI to test Lambda/S3/DynamoDB-dependent code on every pull request without touching a real AWS bill.
A coding bootcamp uses it to teach cloud-native development without requiring students to set up (and pay for) real AWS accounts.
A consultancy builds client demos and prototypes against it before ever provisioning real cloud infrastructure, cutting proof-of-concept costs.

money_ideas.idea: Paid enterprise support/SLA tier for companies relying on it in CI pipelines.

steal_this: Developer infrastructure, not a product opportunity for an outside builder — the realistic move is contributing features and building reputation, not building a business on top of it.
